item.title: [HAPPY NEWS] UT is on sale!
item.description:
Friendly Reminder that historically every time UT had a sale around the time of a Nintendo Direct dropping, a new chapter for DR would be shown in said Direct.
Toby Fox previously said that Chapter 6 was taking less time to develop compared to other DR chapters.
